name: ai-chatbot
description: AI-powered chatbot using Cloudflare Workers AI for real-time conversational responses.

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Your Cloudflare account ID for Workers AI

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN
envVars.description: API token for Cloudflare Workers AI

ai.whenToUse: When the user wants an AI chatbot or conversational assistant embedded in their site, powered by Cloudflare Workers AI.
ai.whenNotToUse: When the project is purely static with no server-side capabilities, or when the user does not need conversational AI.
